title: Revuto - MASTERCARD integration >>> to bring Cardano Native Tokens to Debit Cards supporting crypto <<< and remove friction between crypto liquidity and real-world economic activities -> Subscription Payments!

ms.promise:
・Front-end design (FIGMA) and new UI integration. The new UI will contain updated KYC verification screens to get eligible for the debit cards (document checking with PoA, a short questionnaire for compliance, mobile number verification), screens for: "create a new debit card for the subscription", "add the top-up card", "choose the top-up card to pay with FIAT or Cardano wallet to pay with CNT", control the payments (block, snooze, approve)", upgrade to the Revuto Pro (paying account), downgrade to Revuto Free (freemium account), history of payments, and more.
・Preps for the API integration with the external banking and card issuing provider (creating a flow on the front with all the necessary action buttons to trigger requests on the backend side of the 3rd party platform/banking provider).
ms.criteria:
・UI designs, as described in outputs, are completed in Figma and ready for integration with the Linkcy/Paynovate sandbox (backend).
・The discovery phase of the external (Linkcy/Paynovate) API documentation is completed.
ms.report:
As promised, we're adding a short video (https://youtu.be/K3QgYNrKIXQ) to prove milestone completion. It explains a new user interface supporting the Mastercard Debit Program described in Milestone 1. The presented front-end design is fully completed and ready for integration with the Revuto backend and our partner Linkcy/Paynovate (a signed third-party service provider for card issuing and acquiring), including the integration with the existing Cardano wallet within the Revuto app.
We can grant you access to our Figma project file shown in the video, but not if the information will be publicly available. Our Figma account contains all Revuto mobile app UIX states, of which many are still in development—some show previews of unreleased product features and designs that we're exploring and are confidential. 
Instead of Figma, you can access the new UIX snapshot using this link.
On September 4th, we publicly released the latest bi-weekly development report, which includes updates about the Virtual Debit Card integration described in our Idea Catalyst proposal ID #1200196.
IMPORTANT NOTE:
We started working on the Debit Card product immediately after seeing the Fund 12 voting results and promised to launch it during the Cardano Summit in Dubai. We already paid for a booth at the summit for the product launch and announced the launch to the media. The summit starts in 40 days, so to be on time, we must execute four out of six milestones by then. Today, we were told that the snapshot for the approved milestones is on September 16th, while the following payment is scheduled for September 23rd. As the first payment was late, we must be on point with milestones approval(s) to meet the initial schedule and launch the promised product on time (during the Cardano Summit on October 23rd). To be on time, we'd politely ask you to approve our M1 proof of achievement before the snapshot takes place on September 16th (in 3 days). 
Thank you in advance,
Vedran Vukman, CEO at Revuto.
